crates/application/src/workflow_run/engi.split_plan: Extract graph parsing/validation and indexed traversal into private modules, keeping accepted graph schemas and readiness rules covered by their existing tests.

crates/backend/src/agent_runtime.rs.split_plan: Extract durable session binding/history adoption and runtime command admission from manager ownership. Preserve the single scheduler, supervisor map and session actors; move the corresponding lifecycle tests with each responsibility.

crates/backend/src/agent_runtime/actor.r.split_plan: Separate active-turn event settlement and idle control handling behind private actor operations. Keep one command channel and actor state machine; preserve cancellation, permission and history replay tests.

crates/backend/src/agent_runtime/connect.split_plan: Extract ACP handshake/authentication from connection supervision without duplicating cancellation or process ownership. Keep startup failure and reconnect/shutdown tests at the connection interface.

crates/backend/src/plugin.rs.split_plan: Marketplace release resolution and package transfer now live in plugin/marketplace.rs. Split the remaining private plugin-host configuration and gateway/projection responsibilities while retaining Plugins as the public operations interface. Preserve registry identity, runtime synchronization and Effect generation semantics.

crates/backend/src/workflow/run/executor.split_plan: Extract turn-output collection and baseline/file-change projection from node dispatch. Keep real session lifetime and completion callbacks together; move output/baseline tests alongside their implementation.

crates/db/src/repository/workflow_run_en.split_plan: Group run-state transitions, node/history rows and artifact persistence into private repository modules. Preserve the existing transaction scopes and repository interface, with real SQLite transition tests accompanying extraction.
